purpose: Public trade-data route control only, motivated by no trade publications in maker-observation-v1; not a candidate replacement or strategy trial.
network_budget: One fresh unauthenticated options GET; one recent-trades GET per symbol before and after one 180-second public WebSocket connection; two trade subscriptions and heartbeats only. No retry, recovery, extra markets, window extension or private endpoints.
metadata_rule: Both native symbols must occur exactly in fresh options, with active unscaled base currencies and positive explicit native increments. Currency metadata is not order-placement acceptance.
capture_policy: Preserve original REST bodies and WebSocket frames, hashes, public commands, sequence, wall and monotonic clocks. Stop WebSocket on connection, schema, offset, source-time or clock failure. Preserve REST failures as unavailable; do not silently replace them. Missing terminal or before/after evidence stays incomplete.
price_volume_semantics: Decimal raw values are compared only within the same native symbol. No cross-market prices, fiat conversion, fee calculations, P&L or claimed verified fiat unit. Raw buy/sell labels are not inferred aggressor labels.
comparison_policy: Compare multiset occurrences of exact time/price/volume/raw-type fingerprints; never unique exchange trade IDs. Use post-REST rows and WebSocket publications inside the acknowledged session, excluding five seconds at each boundary. Preserve unmatched occurrences and finite recent-list coverage. Matches do not establish complete exchange history.
outcome_policy: Report fresh positive-volume WebSocket payload observation separately from capture completeness. Positive-volume REST rows inside the guarded session with no matching WebSocket occurrence are cross-source discrepancies, not automatic attribution to exchange, transport or client. No suitable in-window evidence remains inconclusive. No symbol or threshold changes after results.
registration_state: No fresh BTCUSDT or USDTIRT trade list or trade channel requested for this control before registration.
limitations: Short public protocol/availability diagnostic. No maker fills, order queues, trade identity/completeness guarantee, return estimate, account action or live trading.
